notice: Archived answers captured on 31 July 2026 (India, English). A historical snapshot, not a current ranking.
live_observations: none: only the archived answers were analysed
label_note: Labels come from a small local model and are not verified beyond the hand-labelled cases; see the evaluation report.

diagnostics.title: Kasparro appears when the question names it, rarely otherwise
diagnostics.pattern: Mentioned in 37/38 successful answers to branded questions and 22/36 to unbranded ones.
diagnostics.possible_explanation: Engines may not associate Kasparro with the AI-visibility category, so it is only surfaced when the user already knows the name. Not tested here.
diagnostics.test_evidence: Unbranded answers that list other tools without Kasparro; compare against the competitor names they give.

evidence.excerpt: competitors named: Semrush (AI Visibility Toolkit), Peec AI, Rank Math AI Visibility, Ahrefs Brand Radar AI
competitors named: [MindStudio](https://mindstudio.ai/), GeneratePrompt.ai, AI-Powered Research Agents, Teleprompt
competitors named: Profound, ZipTie.dev, Peec AI, Otterly.ai

diagnostics.title: Engines differ in whether a mention becomes a recommendation
diagnostics.pattern: Recommendation rate is lowest on chatgpt (2/31) and highest on aimode (6/19).
diagnostics.possible_explanation: Engines draw on different sources; one may find less third-party material that supports recommending Kasparro. Not tested here.
diagnostics.test_evidence: Answers on chatgpt that mention Kasparro without recommending it.

evidence.excerpt: Enterprise software platforms can improve their visibility in ChatGPT answers, but there isn't a switch that guarantees inclusion.

If your goal is specifically **measuring whether your brand is included, recommended, and cited in AI search answers** (rather than optimizing traditional SEO), the market is still young, but a few platforms stand out.
If you mean **Kasparro** (the B2B SaaS growth/outbound agency, not Kaspr), I couldn't find reliable public pricing or enough verified information to judge whether it's objectively overpriced.
Kasparro's **Four Module Audit Score** appears to be a proprietary assessment framework that measures how visible and "recommendable" a brand is to AI assistants

diagnostics.title: Some answers frame Kasparro as unproven or hard to verify
diagnostics.pattern: 3 of 59 answers that mention Kasparro also say something unfavourable.
diagnostics.possible_explanation: Answers may lack independent reviews or case studies to cite. A citation only shows a link was returned; the pages were not inspected.
diagnostics.test_evidence: Quoted unfavourable passages, one per answer.

evidence.excerpt: I'd be skeptical of taking any single "AI visibility score" at face value.
Profound’s practical entry point is often high ($399/month for full functionality). Alternatives often provide Claude tracking at a lower price point ($59-$99 range)
I would not expect it to reliably make a B2B SaaS product start getting recommended by ChatGPT on its own.

remedies.problem: Mentioned in 37/38 successful answers to branded questions and 22/36 to unbranded ones.
remedies.action: Investigate which sources the unbranded answers draw on, and whether Kasparro is listed in the comparison pages and directories those sources come from.
remedies.expected_benefit: Shows whether category association is the gap.
remedies.effort: low: one analyst day reading cited pages
remedies.uncertainty: High. Engines change; presence in sources may not lead to inclusion.
remedies.validation: Rerun the 25 unbranded prompts after a change and compare mentions.

remedies.problem: 3 of 59 answers that mention Kasparro also say something unfavourable.
remedies.action: Publish verifiable proof that answers can cite: named case studies, method documentation and independent reviews, only where they are true.
remedies.expected_benefit: Gives engines something to cite instead of a lack of evidence.
remedies.effort: medium: depends on customer permission for case studies
remedies.uncertainty: Medium. Engines may not pick up new pages, or may weigh them lightly.
remedies.validation: Track the negative count on the branded prompts across repeated runs.

remedies.problem: Recommendation rate is lowest on chatgpt (2/31) and highest on aimode (6/19).
remedies.action: Compare the citations of the lowest-recommending engine with the others to see which source types it relies on; decide only after that comparison.
remedies.expected_benefit: Targets effort at the engine where the gap is largest.
remedies.uncertainty: High. Based on one snapshot and a small local model's labels.
remedies.validation: Repeat the run on a later snapshot and check whether the gap persists.
